articles.title: ETtech Explainer: Why are dark stores again under scrutiny over food safety
articles.summary: Food safety inspectors in Karnataka and Maharashtra conducted checks on dark stores operated by quick commerce firms Zepto and Blinkit, finding violations related to hygiene, storage, and labeling. The inspections follow the rapid expansion of these stores to enable faster deliveries. The findings could prompt regulatory action under food safety laws. The issue highlights concerns about compliance in the fast-growing quick commerce sector.
articles.raw_summary: Food safety inspectors have conducted thorough checks on quick commerce locations in Karnataka and Maharashtra, revealing violations related to hygiene, storage practices, and labeling standards at both Zepto and Blinkit. The latest actions follow in the wake of quick commerce firms expanding their dark store network to drive growth, improve customer reach, and enable faster deliveries.

articles.title: What is the Perfect Rape Conviction?
articles.summary: The article titled 'What is the Perfect Rape Conviction?' by TheWire.in examines the standards and challenges in securing rape convictions in India. It explores legal and systemic issues in the judicial process related to gender-based violence. The piece highlights the broader implications for women's rights and civil liberties in the context of criminal justice.
